text:
samir: FYI AWS SI reported a backlog in their usage uploads — delta files delayed ~3-4hrs. Some customers show stale entitlements/credits in Console :grimacing:

julia: which customers? any high-dollar ones? have we started throttling invoices?

samir: neil from the partner DM'd a CSV of affected account ids (small set, mostly onboarding). no invoice throttling yet but ledger shows credits not applied.

ben: saw a spike in "missing entitlements" errors in the marketplace webhook logs around 11:05 UTC. ingestion retries were failing with 429 from partner endpoint.

cloud-billing-bot: webhook_retry: partner/webhook/aws-si-42 failed 3x between 2026-03-20T11:02Z and 2026-03-20T11:18Z — backoff scheduled

neil-partner: Hi — our connector fell behind due to S3 lifecycle job interference. We pushed a fix at 11:25 UTC and are re-queuing deltas. ETA for full catch-up ~45m. Apologies.

maria-ops: OK. Temporary plan: 1) run reconciliation for affected accounts once partner confirms backfill complete 2) apply manual credit deltas for Entitlements gap 3) monitor Console entitlements and the billing ledger for double-apply risk.

zane: I can run the reconciliation playbook. Which query do you want me to use? Is ledger backfill safe to idempotently run twice?

maria-ops: Use the idempotent adjustment API (safe):
```
POST /internal/marketplace/adjustment
{
  "partner_id":"aws-si-42",
  "account_ids": ["acct_123","acct_456"],
  "adjustment_type":"credit",
  "amount_units": 12345,
  "reason":"late delta backfill from partner"
}
```
It checks a partner-run heartbeat signature to avoid duplicates. Also run this reconciliation query to reconcile raw usage -> reported credits:
```
SELECT account_id, SUM(delta_tokens) AS pending_tokens
FROM partner_ingest.aws_si_42_deltas
WHERE ingested_at >= '2026-03-20T10:30:00Z'
GROUP BY account_id;
```

samir: tagging @neil-partner — please confirm when re-queue complete and paste the heartbeat checksum (sha256) for our audit.

neil-partner: will do. pushing now, should have checksum in ~25m.

maria-ops: Action items:
- @zane run query + adjustment when partner posts checksum (ASAP)
- @ben watch webhook retry logs and escalate if retries persist
- @julia flag any affected customer CSMs if $ > 10k
I'll post a short postmortem template after reconciliation. :thumbsup:

zane: starting prep. will post results in this thread when done.
